dataset_name: Household spending, Canada, regions and provinces
description: Average annual spending per household by detailed category (about 360 categories and subtotals, from food and shelter to insurance and taxes), from the Survey of Household Spending. The hub uses it to see how much of household budgets goes to essentials such as shelter, which limits how well households can absorb an income shock.
access: Public. Free download, no account or API key required.
access_format: CSV in a ZIP archive (full-table download from a REST API)
retrieval_method: Statistics Canada Web Data Service (WDS) REST API: getFullTableDownloadCSV returns the full-table CSV zip (data and table description); getCubeMetadata returns the title, release time, frequency and expected number of data points.
geography: 1 geographies in source; processed file: Canada
update_frequency: biennial (Survey of Household Spending, every second year since 2017)
refresh_schedule: after each Survey of Household Spending release, 08:30 ET

reproducibility_rating.basis: 2 retrievals on 2 different days produced the same raw data (sha256:ca73e441d228...): 2026-11-07, 2026-11-08

quality_notes: 60 rows in raw file; 60 rows in processed file (all geographies). Missing values: 2 of 60 observations have no value (3.3%): 2 F (too unreliable to be published). Validation passed with warnings. Warnings: date_gaps: 3 annual periods have no data in the whole table: ['2018', '2020', '2022']; 1 series skip periods inside their own date range (1 periods in total), e.g. ["Canada / Average expenditure per household | Collectors' items (e.g. stamps, coins)"] | freshness: latest observation is 2023-01-01, 1407 days old; annual data is normally no more than 913 days old. Check whether the source still updates | period_change: 4 of 51 changes (7.84%) are unusually large and listed for review (QA-OUT2), e.g. ['2023-01-01 Average expenditure per household | Total expenditure: +1.287e+04', '2019-01-01 Average expenditure per household | Total expenditure: +7245', '2023-01-01 Average expenditure per household | Shelter: +3395', '2021-01-01 Average expenditure per household | Transportation: -2638'] Notes (INFO, see validation): missing_share, status_symbols, metadata_completeness.
known_limitations: The survey became biennial after 2017, so 2018, 2020 and 2022 are absent from the table. Categories changed between 2017 and 2019 (some added, some discontinued), so not every category covers every year. Categories are hierarchical (totals and their components), so they must not be summed. Values are in current dollars (not adjusted for inflation).
